purpose: Independent numerical-policy characterization of the C6R root-active Reference total-residual-only rejection. This work unit does not reopen C6R and cannot authorize reduced candidate execution.

frozen_cases.root_feedback: Unchanged C6R committed-state Feddes evaluation with the prescribed sink held fixed inside each hydraulic trial.

shadow_iteration_ceiling.purpose: Distinguish an iteration-cap rejection from a residual floor without changing the C6R contract.

interpretation_rules.SUMMATION_SENSITIVITY: Absolute naive sum and compensated sum lie on opposite sides of the frozen 1e-12 total criterion.
interpretation_rules.ITERATION_CAP_LIMITED: A 32- or 64-iteration shadow solve converges at the exact failed interval with the original 1e-12 criteria.
interpretation_rules.RESIDUAL_FLOOR_PERSISTS: The 64-iteration shadow solve still returns retry-advised and compensated total residual remains above 1e-12.
interpretation_rules.GRID_DEPENDENT_ACCUMULATION: Across 512, 1024 and 2048 nodes, compensated total residual magnitude systematically increases while max local residual remains below 1e-12. This is descriptive only.
interpretation_rules.NO_POLICY_DECISION: No RNP01 outcome changes C6R admission, solver defaults, or any tolerance.

prohibited: No change to Reference Richards, HeadCalc, Feddes, root-sink provider or production runtime.
No acceptance threshold selected from RNP01 output.
next_if_completed: Persist numerical characterization. Any change to Reference numerical policy requires a separate authority and admission work unit.
